facts.business: The company is transitioning from discontinued iron and steel manufacturing operations to agro commodity trading operations effective April 1, 2026.

auditor.name: KRUTESH PATEL & ASSOCIATES
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter on going concern uncertainty due to recurring operational losses, discontinued manufacturing operations, and disputed statutory demands aggregating to ₹1,091.98 lakhs including income-tax matters of ₹939.28 lakhs pending before the Supreme Court.

key_risks: Going concern uncertainty due to recurring operational losses and discontinued manufacturing operations
Material tax litigations with disputed demands aggregating to ₹1,091.98 lakhs including ₹939.28 lakhs pending before Supreme Court
Successful implementation and sustainability of newly commenced agro commodity operations
